main_text.p: quidem assurgere interdum {a}hic autem nonAnton. Campan. in vita Pii II. solùm podagra, aliisque morbis, sed et-iam iam chiragra laborauit. Porrò editionem operis imperfecti si in me censoria nota digna judicent: videant quid dicturi sint pro {b}Cardinalis Palęoti opere, cujus duoDe imaginibus sacris & profanis. libri duntaxat editi sunt de quinque.

p.i: {c}Vt iugulet homines, surgunt[?] de nocte latrones:

main_text.p: {d}Ille,contendens latriam imaginibus,qui-busdam esse debitam, eáque reinstigans ad idololatriam,Palæot. de imag. lib. 1. cap. 32. {e}latrocinium suum præ-matura operis nondum absoluti editione exercet.Ioh. 10. 1. Ego ex adverso præpropere meū edo,ut meipsum servem & eos qui me audierint,quemadmodum {f}Timotheum su-um monet Paulus.1. Tim. 4. 16. Nam qui {g}væ mihi de-nunciatum didici, nisi evangelizem; nec1. Cor. 9. 16. voce propter corporis & laterum infirmi-tatem perinde possum, atque olim; evangelizo manu & scriptione,quoad possum: ut {h}Cynægirus Atheniensis, quū fugien-tes Persas ad naves egisset, onustam na-uem dextra manu tenuit eáque amputa-ta,navem sinistra comprehendit; quam & ipsam quum amisset, ad postremum morsu navem detinuit.Iustin. hist. lib. 2. Itaque, neglectis censuris iniquorum, judicium facti mei, ut in primis tibi, Comes illustrissime, sic

page.notes: The margin notes are printed in small type on the right. Doubtful readings: "surgunt" (printed as an f-like form, perhaps "furgunt"), "treipsum" (the first word is unclear), and the first word of the verse line "serves" (printed with a long s). The bare "16." beside "nec" may be a verse number for note g rather than a separate note; I have left it inside note g. The "16." under note f is read as part of f. The page has no page number, catchword or signature.
